title: Why Astrology Is a Scam, Even When It’s Right
description:
When India lost to England in the T20 World Cup semifinal, astrologers across TV channels were left red-faced. 11 jyotishis had confidently predicted an Indian win — and all were wrong. But should we really troll them for it?

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts explains why astrology is a scam even if predictions come true. India had a 50% chance of winning the match before it began — just like England. Astrology adds no value to this probability. When predictions go wrong, people laugh. But when they go right, astrology is wrongly seen as validated. This is how superstition survives.

We explore why planets and stars cannot influence cricket matches or human life, how prophecies are molded to fit events, and why “hits” are remembered while “misses” are forgotten. From Rahu and Shani to so-called “favorable houses,” astrology is nothing more than a guessing game dressed up as science.

If you’ve searched for “astrology cricket prediction fail,” “India vs England astrologers,” “astrology debunked,” “jyotish predictions wrong,” “astrology scam explained,” or “why astrology is fake”, this video breaks down how pseudoscience hides behind probability and coincidence. Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe to expose superstition with science.

00:00 India vs England: Astrologers predict wrong
01:15 Why trolling jyotishis is counterproductive
03:00 Astrology and the 50% chance fallacy
05:10 Astrology is a scam even if predictions are correct
07:00 Prophecies and how they are molded
09:20 Predictions vs real forecasting
